cat > programs/task-9c89926b.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[1 if x == background else 0 for x in row] for row in grid]
PY
